title: Liangcang Cave (Qingliang Cave) — a living cave temple near Anshun
originalTitle: 贵州深山洞中发现一房子，女子竟独自隐居在洞里十多年，与世无争｜Guizhou woman lives in seclusion in cave for more than ten years
location: Qingliang village area, Xixiu, Anshun, Guizhou, China
note: The creator identifies Liangcang Cave (粮仓洞), also called Qingliang Cave (清凉洞), at 2:48. A temple occupies a natural cavern with spring-fed pools. The exact entrance coordinates are still being checked; this film has no map pin yet. Historical origin stories are presented as local traditions.
